evidence.evidence_summary: Ward threw for 4,123 yards, 39 TDs, and 7 INTs at Miami (FL) in 2024, leading the ACC and earning the #1 overall pick as the consensus best QB in the class. His elite volume, efficiency, and touchdown production place him in the top tier.
2024 Heisman runner-up; 2,601 rushing yards and 29 TDs. Elite production at age 20 vs Mountain West competition.
73 rec, 1,233 yds, 8 TDs in 2024 — best TE production season in B1G history. Senior who bloomed late but dominated at 22; late breakout age is the main NFL alpha concern.

Fannin shattered MAC records in 2024 with 116 receptions, 1,503 receiving yards, and 10 TDs at Bowling Green, producing one of the most statistically dominant TE seasons in college football history. The Browns drafted him first pick of the 2nd round despite questions about MAC competition level.
1,402 receiving yards and 14 TDs in 2024. First impact season at 20; Pac-12 (now Big 12) elite WR with elite catch radius (6'4").
2024 Heisman winner (2-way; WR+CB). First true impact at 19 as Colorado freshman; recovered from gunshot injury in 2023. Dual-role usage at NFL level unlikely — evaluated purely as WR.
2024: 1,577 rush yds, 22 rush TDs, 267 rec yds (25 total TDs) — led Big 12, set UCF career TD record (48). Elite volume scorer with big-play ability; 4.40 speed at 205 lbs.

Dart threw for 4,279 yards and 29 TDs with only 7 INTs at Ole Miss in 2024 under Lane Kiffin's pass-heavy system in the SEC, showing strong volume and decision-making. His late first-round selection to the Giants reflects a strong but not transcendent NFL projection.

Arroyo caught 46 passes for 679 yards and 7 TDs at Miami (FL) in 2024, serving as the Hurricanes' top tight end with strong red-zone production and impressive athleticism. Seattle added him alongside Milroe in the 2025 draft, targeting his receiving ability and athletic upside.

Taylor caught 66 passes for 792 yards and 7 TDs in 2024 at LSU, functioning as the primary pass-catching tight end in the SEC with reliable hands and a strong size-speed combination. His top-2 TE standing in the class earned him a 2nd-round selection by the Jets.

Gadsden caught 58 passes for 711 yards and 8 TDs in 2024 at Syracuse, functioning as an in-line and split-out matchup weapon with elite athleticism for the position. The Dolphins targeted his receiving upside and natural catch radius in the 3rd round.

Howard threw for 3,917 yards, 33 TDs, and 5 INTs leading Ohio State to the 2024 national championship, showing elite efficiency and turnover avoidance in the Big Ten. The Eagles selected him in the 2nd round to develop behind their roster as the transfer-portal veteran with championship pedigree.
Back-to-back 1,500+ yard seasons at UNC. ACC premier back with excellent YPC and pass-catching role.
87 receptions for 1,183 yards and 9 TDs in 2024 at Iowa State; AP Third-Team All-American with 2.66 YPRR. Transferred from Eastern Kentucky (FCS) where he first broke out at age 19.

Transfer from Illinois; first major impact at Missouri age 19. 1,212 rec yds in 2024; SEC competition elevates production value. YAC-first profile — elite after-catch ability and burst, primarily slot/underneath usage. Screen production concern: research notes flag screen-heavy usage at Missouri as a potential production quality discount (manufactured vs. earned yards). screen_yard_share field pending precise data — current model does not apply translation penalty until confirmed. If screen_yard_share > 0.40 is confirmed, expect -3.0 to -5.0 pts on production. Natural comp to Deebo Samuel slot-first archetype; scheme fit at NFL level is a significant variable.

96 receptions (led Big Ten and all Power-conference players), 1,124 yards, 9 TDs in 2024 at Maryland; first-team All-Big Ten and third-team All-American. Elite volume producer with 4.37 speed.
First impact season at Ole Miss age 19 (1,567 rush yds). Transferred to Ohio State; combined CFP title run adds SEC+B1G bona fides.
Super senior (started at UCF, Oklahoma, Oregon over 6 college seasons). Elite production everywhere but 24 years old at time of 2025 draft; limited upside runway.
Led B1G in rushing 2024 (1,537 yds, 21 TDs). Scheme-adjusted production strong despite Iowa's conservative offense.

Shough threw for over 3,200 yards and approximately 23 TDs at Louisville in 2024, showing consistency as a tall, veteran pocket passer in the ACC after a lengthy injury-plagued career at Texas Tech. His size-arm talent combination attracted 2nd-round interest despite the injury history.
2024: 1,491 rush yds, 22 TDs — SEC Offensive Player of Year; broke Tennessee single-season rushing TD record (1929). Elite scorer at 20 in the SEC.
4,134 passing yards, 37 TDs in 2024. Significant draft slide (projected top-5, fell to ~4th round) introduces uncertainty. Production strong but behind weak OL at Colorado.
Elite breakout at 19 (1,248 rush yds, B1G freshman). Injuries in 2022-2023 limited ceiling; injury risk a persistent context flag.

evidence.evidence_summary: Milroe posted 2,834 passing yards, 19 TDs, and 9 INTs in 2024 at Alabama while adding 531 rushing yards, demonstrating elite dual-threat athleticism but struggling with accuracy and turnovers in the SEC. The Seahawks invested a 3rd-round pick in his mobility and development upside.

Ferguson totaled 43 receptions for 527 yards and 4 TDs in 2024 at Oregon in the Big Ten, projecting as an athletic move tight end with receiving upside and blocking versatility. His athleticism and ability to line up all over the formation drew the Rams' interest in the 2nd round.

Senior declare from Ohio State. First impact at 20; shared targets with Marvin Harrison Jr. for most of collegiate career — target suppression context applies. 1,147 rec yds in 2024 in a split-target offense. Deep-yard share: 16.6% (confirmed) — below severe threshold (18%). Ohio State used him primarily in slot/intermediate role rather than as a vertical threat; deep-yard share reflects role design rather than inability, but it still limits translation evidence for NFL alpha projection at early draft capital. Route-running and inside-out versatility are legitimate NFL skills; the deep-yard share discount is a production-quality adjustment, not a talent flag.
2024: 1,343 rush yds, 7 TDs, 21 rec/258 yds — All-Big 12 2nd team; career 6.0 YPC across 3,087 yds. Rare size-speed combo (6-0, 4.43).

Transfer from Houston; breakout at Texas in 2024 (987 rec yds). Elite speed (4.29 forty) at 185lb with solid route tree development.

60 receptions, 1,030 yards, 7 TDs in just 8 games (2024); led all CFB with an unprecedented 5.15 YPRR — first Power-conference WR ever to exceed 5.00 YPRR (PFF). Injury limited his final year to 8 of 12 games.

63 receptions, 831 yards, 6 TDs in 2024 at Stanford (second-team All-ACC); back-to-back 1,000+ yard equivalent seasons, including a school-record 294-yard game vs. Colorado in 2023. Young breakout in 2023 at age 20.

2024: 1,115 rush yds, 8 TDs at Clemson — 24th 1,000-yard season in school history. Big-bodied power runner (234 lbs) who opted out of combine testing.

55 receptions, 834 yards, 6 TDs in just 7 games (2024) before foot injury ended season; in 2023 set Utah State record with 15 TDs (71/1080). Mountain West production caveat but elite rate stats suggest real talent.

Leonard guided Notre Dame to the 2024 national championship game with 2,445 passing yards and 18 TDs alongside 506 rushing yards, but his modest passing volume reflected Notre Dame's run-first system. His mobility, leadership, and winning pedigree translated to a 4th-round Cowboys selection.
42 receptions, 783 yards, 2 TDs in 2024 at Florida (transfer from Wisconsin); led Gators in catches but modest production. Known for special teams value — elite 4.34 speed and elite punt returner.

2024: 948 rush yds, 12 TDs at Michigan — only one full season as RB (converted from LB). Big Ten production; elite size (6-2, 226 lbs) with developmental upside.

McCord transferred from Ohio State to Syracuse and threw for 3,722 yards and 27 TDs in 2024, demonstrating strong ACC production but facing questions about arm strength and NFL-caliber competition. His late-round selection reflects developmental upside with limited immediate starting projection.

2024: 880 rush yds, 13 TDs — down year after Doak Walker 2023 (1,656 yds, 20 TDs). Physical 226-lb north-south runner with 36 career TDs.

Knee injury in 2024 (5 games, 26/353/1 TDs); 2023 was a full season with 71/1,131/8 TDs for first-team All-Mountain West. Two-time All-Mountain West selection but Mountain West competition level is a caveat.

48 receptions, 817 yards, 4 TDs in 2024 at Georgia; led Bulldogs in receiving yards but had program-high 10 drops. Extensive injury history (wrist, knee, fibula, ankle) offset by elite 4.36 speed and two national championships.

Only 28 receptions for 545 yards and 3 TDs in 2024 at Arkansas (P4 role player); elite 19.5 YPR and great combine athleticism (6'3.5", 4.43). Previously dominant at Hillsdale (D2) with 68/1325/13 in 2022.

Miller was a productive FCS quarterback at North Dakota State with strong TD-to-INT ratios and multiple FCS championships, but his FCS-level competition heavily discounted his production in NFL evaluations. He went undrafted, reflecting the steep talent-level adjustment required.
